metaDescription: Tekpoint is AGIBOT’s regional distributor for Europe. Explore A2 Ultra, X2 Ultra and G2 robots and discuss your application with our Robotics team.
title: Tekpoint — European regional distributor for AGIBOT robots
intro: Tekpoint has been a trusted technology partner for European businesses, connecting them with leading manufacturers and emerging innovations. Robotics is our newest focus: as embodied AI moves from research labs into factories, warehouses, and service environments, we help European companies access this technology through a local, reliable partner.

As AGIBOT's regional distributor, we provide sales, support, and integration for AGIBOT's humanoid robot platform — giving customers across Europe a direct point of contact instead of navigating an overseas manufacturer alone.
heroAlt: AGIBOT humanoid robots — the manufacturer’s 15,000th robot milestone
newsLink: AGIBOT reaches 15,000 robots: read the story
productsIntro: A selection of AGIBOT's humanoid robots available through Tekpoint.

products.name: AGIBOT A2 Ultra
products.tagline: World's First Commercially Scaled Full-Size Humanoid
products.description: Intelligent interaction, autonomous operation, and a reliable body built for large-scale commercial deployment. 169cm, 40 degrees of freedom and walking speed up to 1.2 m/s. AGIBOT associates A2 Ultra with its 106.286 km walking record; Guinness World Records names the record-setting robot as AgiBot A2.

products.name: AGIBOT X2 Ultra
products.description: Friendly, agile, and intelligent, with multimodal interaction across vision, voice, touch, and facial expression. Approx. 1.31m tall, up to 30 degrees of freedom, and walking speed up to 1.8 m/s, with autonomous navigation and obstacle avoidance.

products.name: AGIBOT G2
products.description: Built to industrial-grade standards with 100% automotive-grade components and IP42 protection. Delivers sub-millimeter precision assembly with force-controlled arms, plus expressive facial animation, human-like movement, and eye-gaze tracking for human interaction.

manufacturerSpecs: Product descriptions and specifications supplied by AGIBOT. Configuration and suitability are assessed for each project.
